title: Parley — Open Request
description: Request body for POST /api/pact/parleys (§19.3.1). Opens an ephemeral negotiation; the caller's handler supplies the first Mandate, verified per §20.4 before the Parley opens. Added in PACT v2.1 (§19) per RFC #14.

purpose.description: What this Parley is about. Recorded verbatim; used for §19.6 binding_scope evaluation.

ttl_seconds.description: Time budget in seconds (§19.3.1 bounds, stated in prose), bounded by the SERVER clock (§19.5). Expiry closes the Parley with outcome `timeout`.

max_participants.description: Declared party count (§19.2). Accepts beyond this are 409 parley.full; the Parley activates when every slot has accepted and joined.

mandate.description: The opening handler's Mandate (§20.2). session_id MAY be null at open.

facilitator.description: OPTIONAL principal id of an opt-in third-party facilitator (D5: peer-to-peer by default).

predecessor_parley_id.description: OPTIONAL reference to an earlier Parley (round 2+). Parleys are islanded by default (§19.3.1); single-hop, no transitivity.

outcome_binding.description: Advisory by default (ratified Q3). `commitment` requires both Mandates to pre-authorise binding outcomes and per-handler §17.6 proofs at close (§19.6).
